name: Foundry v13 adapter — core-API profile
description: Runs Foundry VTT modules through AIS. Profile foundry-module loads an unmodified module.json distribution (ES modules via blob URLs + import map) and maps Foundry core APIs — settings, i18n, modules, notifications, hooks, active-scene documents, transient FX — onto AIS services; profile foundry-v13-scene-tags-fx keeps the 0.1.0 bundled-guest behaviour. Never Foundry core code, never the parent renderer. Approve each guest separately.
